entry.title: Overcast 1.1.0
entry.summary: Mutable Instruments Clouds with the Parasites firmware (six modes) plus a modulation page: two envelopes, two LFOs and an 8-slot matrix onto Clouds' CV inputs, and a built-in manual. **1.1.0 is built with Akai's official MPC Plugin SDK** and runs on **MPC OS 3.10.1** with Enhancements → External Plugin Support.
